title: Are Your Reasoning Models Reasoning or Guessing? A Mechanistic Analysis of Hierarchical Reasoning Models
note: under review at NeurIPS 2026 · first author
figLabel: fig 1. latent-state trajectories of hierarchical reasoners
abstract: We perform a systematic mechanistic study of hierarchical reasoning models (HRMs). By probing latent-state trajectories and structural geometry, we identify critical violations of fixed-point assumptions and a hidden "guessing" shortcut in advanced reasoners. We propose three training-free augmentation techniques that improve HRM accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme from 55% to 97%, and release an open-source pipeline.

title: LLM×MapReduce-V2: Entropy-Driven Convolutional Test-Time Scaling for Generating Long-Form Articles from Extremely Long Resources
authors: Haoyu Wang, Yujia Fu, Zhu Zhang, Shuo Wang, Zirui Ren, Xiaorong Wang, Zhili Li, Chaoqun He, Bo An, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun
abstract: We develop a test-time scaling framework inspired by convolutional architectures, enabling high-fidelity long-form text generation from extremely long inputs. The method is deployed in SurveyGO, ModelBest's production-level academic survey platform.
